recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To improve your CV and job matching for the position at SynergisticIT, focus on organizing your skills more clearly, gaining experience with missing technologies, and providing measurable results for your projects.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Organize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: The skills section is not well organized, making it harder to quickly identify technical competencies, which is crucial for matching job requirements.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis indicates that the skills section lacks organization, affecting clarity.

recommended_actions.action_description: Organize the skills section into categories such as Programming Languages, Tools, and Concepts for better clarity.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Improved clarity and readability of the CV, making it easier for recruiters to identify relevant skills.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Include Measurable Results in Projects
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Lack of measurable results or achievements in project descriptions can weaken the impact of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis notes that no specific measurable outcomes or impacts from projects are provided.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, include specific measurable results or impacts to demonstrate effectiveness and contributions.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Enhanced credibility and impact of project descriptions, making your CV more compelling.
